about: Pilots and artifacts: the ONE spec. Tools/Build/author_pilot_assets.py writes the Unity assets from it (--check is the drift gate). Design: Docs/Pilots/CALLSIGNS.md (one pilot per callsign, any vessel; Garrett 2026-10-27) and Docs/Pilots/ARTIFACTS.md (an artifact is a payload transformation with four element tracks, 0-10, a twist at 5; no vessel class appears in an artifact). Ids are saved by players: never rename one. Text is printable ASCII (the UI font has no other glyphs).

artifacts.name: Javelin
artifacts.description: Throws the payload down your heading. It cracks every rival super-shield along its line and bursts where it stops.

tracks.label: line width
tracks.twist: Its final burst reaches twice as far.

tracks.label: range
tracks.twist: It pierces: it never stops for what it cracks.

tracks.label: linger seconds
tracks.twist: The whole line lingers, cracking what is rebuilt along it.

artifacts.name: Aegis
artifacts.description: Release the payload beside your Ark and it super-shields the Ark's hull for a while, guarding everything aboard.

transformTuning.notHomeLine: AEGIS - RELEASE IT BESIDE YOUR ARK

tracks.label: seconds
tracks.twist: When it ends it leaves an ordinary shield behind.

tracks.label: re-raises
tracks.twist: A cracked plate re-raises at once.
